item.title: Version 1.0.33
item.description:
fix: app icon now sized like every other Mac app

The 1.0.28 squircle fix solved the SHAPE (square corners → rounded)
but the icon still rendered at the full 1024px canvas with no
padding, which made it look oversized next to other apps in the
Dock and Launchpad.

Apple's macOS HIG specifies the visible icon should occupy roughly
824x824 inside a 1024x1024 canvas, with ~100px transparent padding
on each side.  Rebuilt to that spec — should now match the visual
weight of Finder / Mail / Safari / etc.
